htmlIngredientLines: ▢ 1 (14 oz/ 396 g) package firm tofu, drained (Ensure you use 14 oz/396 g of firm tofu. Tofu block sizes can vary, and other types, such as extra-firm or silken tofu, are not ideal and may affect the final result.)
▢ 2 teaspoons vegetable broth powder, vegetable instant stock mix powder, vegetable bouillon base, or 1 vegetable bouillon cube
▢ 1 ½ teaspoons soy sauce or ½ teaspoon salt
